checks.rule: Every situation has a cell, and only those; a scope writes only its own blocks
checks.source: GDD §09 (nothing hand-authored; unknown = reject): every situation the rulebook and the people rules can produce has a cell, and no cell is for one they cannot; the blocks a scope writes are exactly its own

checks.rule: Everyone speaks: every person of the groups in scope has all their lines and scenes
checks.source: GDD §04 person = routine + need + temperament + memory; §09 dialogue from person data: every person of the groups in scope has a line for every situation they can be in, a Listen scene and a Watch scene

checks.rule: Every filled line fits: at most 80 characters, spoken lines 1–12 words, sentence ends, 2–4 variants
checks.source: dialogue.rules.json limits (the Handover's text.test.ts: a line ≤ 80 characters, a spoken line 1–12 words, ends like a sentence, 2–4 variants); GDD §10 text is a light layer

checks.rule: Slots: only the allowed ones, each filled, none left over
checks.source: dialogue.rules.json slots: only the slots the context allows, every slot filled for every person who reaches it, none left in a filled line

checks.rule: Names: the tables name no one; a scene names only the two people on its tie
checks.source: GDD §09/§14 history, not backstory: the tables name no one; a scene names only the two people on its tie (the Handover's "no uncast names")

checks.rule: Tone: no modern speech, strong profanity, explicit or gory words, no gendered words; civilians are never the payload
checks.source: GDD §09 tone + rating filters; dialogue.rules.json tone (avoid, profanity, rating, gendered, payload); GDD §14 civilians are never the payload

checks.rule: Signal words: none of the cell's words in a person's mouth, no digits, nothing awaiting Sky
checks.source: dialogue.rules.json tone.signal and tone.pending: the game's own words are the cell's, a person says no digits, and no line names what awaits Sky

checks.rule: No repeats: within a cell, a group, a scope or a scene
checks.source: the Handover's text.test.ts: no two lines repeat, and no cell repeats its own (GDD §09 risk: sameness)

checks.rule: Knowledge: a cold approach surfaces no need; qualified cells name a need or secret of the rules
checks.source: GDD §04 knowledge: a cold Ask or a Pay surfaces no need; a qualified cell is for a need or secret the rules list, on the replies and questioning that read them; dialogue.rules.json limits.qualifiedCellsPerGroup

checks.rule: The expansion is deterministic and valid as suborned.lines/1
checks.source: GDD §01/§09 same orders → same result: the expansion is byte-identical twice and valid as suborned.lines/1

checks.rule: Scenes: a focus who speaks, a partner only on a tie, the Scout only in a Watch, 3–6 beats, variants that differ
checks.source: brief 012: a scene has a focus who speaks, a partner only where the tie gives one, the Scout only in a Watch, 3–6 beats, 2–3 variants that differ

checks.rule: The lexicon words every need, position, temperament, debrief line and summons key, each debrief line with its cause
checks.source: people.rules needs, positions and roles; the rulebook debrief.lines fields ("the debrief reports each with cause"); the engine's summons codes: the lexicon words every one, and a debrief line carries its cause

checks.rule: The Handover's reference lines are matched: the same situations, as many variants
checks.source: GDD §14 the Handover is the reference: every situation its hand-written text gives a person of the voice, the tables give too, in as many variants
